  O -->|"G 갱신: D를 속이도록"| G
  FK -.->|"활용"| AP["합성데이터·증강·딥페이크"]

generative-adversarial-network.pseudocode:
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    for x_real in batches(data):
        z = sample_noise(BATCH)
        x_fake = G(z)
        # 1) 판별자: 진짜는 1, 가짜는 0으로 분류
        loss_d = -mean(log(D(x_real))
                       + log(1 - D(x_fake)))
        update(D, grad(loss_d))
        # 2) 생성자: D가 가짜를 진짜로 판단하도록
        z = sample_noise(BATCH)
        loss_g = -mean(log(D(G(z))))  # 비포화 손실
        update(G, grad(loss_g))

genetic-algorithm.pseudocode:
def genetic_algorithm(pop, fitness, gens, pc=0.8, pm=0.01):
    for _ in range(gens):
        ranked = sorted(pop, key=fitness, reverse=True)
        nxt = ranked[:2]  # 엘리트 보존
        while len(nxt) < len(pop):
            p1 = tournament(ranked, fitness)  # 선택
            p2 = tournament(ranked, fitness)
            if random() < pc:  # 1점 교차
                cut = randint(1, len(p1) - 1)
                child = p1[:cut] + p2[cut:]
            else:
                child = p1[:]
            child = [1 - g if random() < pm else g
                     for g in child]  # 비트 돌연변이
            nxt.append(child)
        pop = nxt
    return max(pop, key=fitness)
